summary.text: Joshua Dobrovich is a Republican who has represented Orange-3, which includes Chelsea and Williamstown, in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2025.
He sits on the House Committee on Education and the Canvassing Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dobrovich lives in Williamstown with his wife and two daughters, according to his House biography.
After starting in the automotive and lending industries, he works to provide affordable housing in central Vermont.
He serves on the Paine Mountain School District Board, and his biography says he is committed to reforming education funding and expanding vocational arts.
